title: Fix prime-source bool helper ABI
objective: Fix the generic bool-returning buffer-mutating prime-source helper ABI with a neutral source-transparent regression

oracles: neutral CPython/dynamic/native and emitted C ABI differential

handoff.summary: Corrected the generic prime-source bool result ABI: generated core/header result slots and Node adapter locals now use C int consistently with bool IR locals instead of mixing int callers with uint64_t pointer callees. Added a neutral bool-returning, UInt64Buffer-mutating helper under PrimeFieldModulus with zero-callback emitted-core/header/adapter assertions and CPython, dynamic Sage.js, and native differentials. A temporary restoration of the original bool-returning production Jacobian helper compiled all 32 native functions after the fix.
risks: The branch-base architecture check is blocked before native architecture checks by an unrelated existing package budget: hyperelliptic-curves-heights is 534848 bytes against a 510000-byte budget.
The focused compiler and complete native-kernel harness passed, but the repository-wide pnpm test:native tier remains for integration because it rebuilds and exercises every optional native package.
next_steps: Cherry-pick b4d34e2a and rebuild the production native-kernel pack.

After integration validates the restored bool shape, the hyperelliptic consumer may replace its temporary uint64 0/1 helper workaround with the semantically direct bool return in a separate math commit.
